entities.name: Yasuzō Nojima
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yasuzō Nojima  was a Japanese photographer. He is particularly well known for his unidealized nudes of "ordinary" Japanese women executed in both pictorialist and modernist styles. His work ranged from kaiga shugi shashin to Shinkō shashin in the early twentieth century.
